subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements about Akbar are true?

1 He introduced the Mansabdari system.

2 He defeated and merged the state of Bijapur in his empire.

3 He made Fatehpur Sikri his capital.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Only 1 and 3__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Akbar introduced the** Mansabdari system** to organize the military and administration.
 
• He established **Fatehpur Sikri** as his capital but later abandoned it due to water shortages.
 
• Akbar is known for his policy of religious tolerance and founded the **Din-i-Ilahi** to promote unity among different religions.
 
• He expanded the Mughal Empire significantly through both diplomacy and warfare, including the conquest of **Gujarat** and **Bengal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **‘Mansab**’ is an Arabic word meaning rank position or status of a person. 
 
• Mansabdari was a system in which the rank of a **government official **was determined. 
 
• Every** civil** and** military** officer was given a ‘mansab’. Different numbers which could be divided by ten were used for ranking officers.
 
• During the early reign of Akbar, the lowest grade was **ten **and the highest was **5000**. Towards the end of the reign, it was raised to **7000**.
 
• Higher Mansabs were given to **princes** and **Rajput** rulers who accepted the suzerainty of Akbar.
 
• the state of **Bijapur** was one of the most powerful states in South Asia, second to the Mughal Empire, which was conquered in **1686 **under **Aurangzeb**.
